name: @email-editor/service
description: Lumitra Mail: the multi-tenant mail service (API, and from S2 the send worker and hosted pages)

scripts.dev: INFISICAL_TOKEN="$($HOME/software-dev/infra/scripts/infisical-mi-token.sh)" infisical run --projectId=f868ed33-e6d0-4f12-9075-7ee1ea7fd7a4 --domain=https://infisical.lumitra.co --env=dev -- sh -c "tsx src/main.ts migrate && tsx watch src/main.ts serve"
scripts.db:dev: docker start lumitra-mail-dev-db 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name lumitra-mail-dev-db -p 55432:5432 -e POSTGRES_USER=mail -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=mail -e POSTGRES_DB=lumitra_mail postgres:17-alpine
